Governor Henry McMaster and the First Family Announce the 60th Annual Governor's Carolighting

JR Berry, a WLTX News Anchor, to Emcee Event

        November 17, 2026

COLUMBIA, S.C. –
 Governor Henry McMaster and First Lady Peggy McMaster will celebrate the beginning of the holiday season with the 60th Annual Governor's Carolighting at the South Carolina Statehouse's North Steps on Sunday, November 22 at 6:00 PM. Those unable to attend in person can view the event on television or 
online via SCETV.

"Peggy and I look forward to bringing South Carolinians together for the beginning of the Christmas season at the 60th annual Carolighting," said Governor Henry McMaster. "This cherished tradition is an opportunity to share in the joy of the season and celebrate what makes this time of year so special." 
The program will feature a mix of traditional carols, performances by local artists, and the lighting of South Carolina's official Christmas tree.
This year's State Christmas tree is a 35-foot-tall Norway Spruce from Henderson Tree Farms in Morganton, N.C. The tree was purchased by the Columbia Garden Club with support from the Garden Club of South Carolina. TimberTech of Greer, S.C. donated their delivery services to bring the tree to Columbia for the 22nd consecutive year. 

JR Berry, a WLTX News anchor, will serve as the evening’s emcee.
